entries.title: II Chronicles 13:1
segments: And in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam Abijah began to reign over Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:2
segments: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also [was] Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:3
segments: And Abijah set the battle in order with an army of mighty men of war, four hundred thousand chosen men. Jeroboam also set the battle in order against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, mighty men of valor.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:4
segments: And Abijah stood up on mount Zemaraim, in the hills of Ephraim, and said, Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:5
segments: Should you not know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:6
segments: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, has risen up and has rebelled against his lord.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:7
segments: And there are gathered to him vain men, the sons of Belial, and have made themselves strong against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, and Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted and could not withstand them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:8
segments: And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hands of the sons of David. And you [are] a great multitude, and there [are] with you golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:9
segments: Have you not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made priests to yourselves like the peoples of the lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams, he may be a priest of [those who are] no gods.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:10
segments: But as for us, Jehovah [is] our God, and we have not forsaken Him. And the priests who minister to the LORD are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in the work.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:11
segments: And they burn to the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense, and the showbread on the pure table, and the lampstand of gold with its lamps, to burn every evening. For we keep the charge of the LORD our God. But you have forsaken Him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:12
segments: And behold, God Himself [is] with us as Commander, and His priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O sons of Israel, do not fight against the LORD God of your fathers, for you shall not prosper!

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:13
segments: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come around behind them, so that they were in front of Judah, and the ambush [was] behind them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:14
segments: And Judah turned, and, behold, the battle [was] before and behind. And they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:15
segments: And the men of Judah shouted. And it happened as the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:16
segments: And the sons of Israel fled before Judah. And God delivered them into their hand.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:17
segments: And Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter. And there fell down dead five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:18
segments: And the sons of Israel were humbled at that time, and the sons of Judah won because they relied on the LORD God of their fathers.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:19
segments: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages, and Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephrain with its villages.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:20
segments: And Jeroboam did not recover strength again [in] the days of Abijah. And the LORD struck him and he died.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:21
segments: And Abijah became mighty, and married fourteen wives, and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:22
segments: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, [are] written in the inquiry of the prophet Iddo.
